name: Pla de Bages

known.via: English Wikipedia "Pla de Bages" (a wine place on Wikidata)

communes: Pont De Vilomara I Rocafort, El

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Catalan DO in Barcelona province. Allowed grapes include Picapoll Blanco and Picapoll Negro, plus Macabeo, Parellada, Tempranillo and Merlot.
